name: 胡江
title: AI | MLOps
headline: I'm Hu Jiang.
tagline: AI engineering, MLOps, multimodal models, and data flywheels.
introEnglish: I build production AI systems across model training, automated evaluation, inference deployment, and LLM/Agent-driven data flywheels. Recent work spans multimodal content understanding, DPO preference optimization, VLM data production, synthetic data generation, and high-QPS model iteration loops.
introChinese: 我专注 AI 工程化与模型运维，经验覆盖数据挖掘、训练调优、自动化评测、推理部署和数据飞轮闭环。近期工作聚焦多模态内容理解、DPO 偏好优化、VLM 训练数据生产、Agentic 数据蒸馏与高 QPS 模型上线体系。
resumeSummary: AI / MLOps 工程师，能把模型训练、数据生产、自动评测和推理部署串成可持续迭代的生产链路。近期在多模态召回、内容分类、Push 风控和 VLM 数据生产中落地 DPO、SFT、Agentic 数据蒸馏与批量推理优化。
